testcase.name: organization meetings require both start and end times with a strictly increasing range
deputies receive only their tasks, their followups and invited meetings, including on a fresh full sync
guessed IDs, stale operations and another user receipt never expose a different deputy task
deputy cannot change assignment, title, date, priority, delete or approve; chief alone approves REVIEW
reassignment revokes cached parent and notes, and exposes all existing child history to the new assignee
removing a meeting invite revokes meeting data and projects the retained own task without the hidden meeting
inviting someone to an old meeting works even with no new task revision, and cross-company IDs are rejected
account creation, reset and deactivation are admin-only, revoke sessions and protect the last chief
deputy can append a report to own task; unrelated or editable reports and meeting writes are blocked
stale authorized edits receive the current version and canonical review/report receipts survive lost responses
push outbox contains only the chief and allowed assignee/invitees, never other deputies
inventory pagination catches up without omissions and does not repeatedly return unknown tombstones
two accounts share meetings and tasks while another workspace is isolated
idempotent retries return the original receipt; stale and simultaneous edits conflict
meeting deletion detaches tasks; task deletion tombstones followups
credentials, logout, invalid payloads and cross-workspace references are enforced
a deleted parent blocks its pending child without blocking unrelated queued work
